fields.name: content_pretitle
fields.label: Pretitle
fields.description: Small label shown above the title (e.g. Unlock Your Financial Freedom)

fields.name: content_points
fields.label: Points
fields.description: Key highlights as a bulleted list

fields.name: content_note
fields.label: Note
fields.description: Text below the button, may include a link (e.g. New customer? Apply with Kotak811 A/c)

fields.name: ctaLinkText
fields.label: Button Text
fields.description: Label shown on the button (e.g. Apply Now)

fields.name: video
fields.label: Background Video (DAM)
fields.description: MP4 video asset from DAM. Shows in the editor; may not play on the published site unless DAM video delivery is enabled. Prefer the URL field below for published pages.

fields.name: videoUrl
fields.label: Background Video URL
fields.description: Absolute URL to an MP4 (e.g. https://...mp4). Used on the published site; takes priority over the DAM asset.
